notes.coverage_gaps_found: None. All 9 AC map to at least one automated, independently re-run test (fitness or unit/integration) — no manual-only AC in this task's contract.
notes.adversarial_probe_performed_per_task_ins: Per the review brief's explicit instruction ('SQL-ом в ROLLBACK сделай вызывающего НЕ-админом и убедись живым HTTP, что deepLinks нет в сыром теле'): registered a live tenant via the real registerTenant() path (owner starts isGenesisOwner=true, i.e. admin by construction — confirmed via a baseline probe showing deepLinks present). Then, via a SEPARATE raw pg.Client connection, ran a committed UPDATE choros.role_assignment SET valid_until=1 WHERE tenant_id=<t> AND employee_id=<owner's employee row> — revoking ALL of that actor's role_assignment rows (both the tenant-owner assignment that drives isGenesisOwner and any other assignment that could grant adminGrants). This is the same actorSlug the live HTTP server's own connection pool resolves against — a genuine DB-state change, not a mock or stub. Sent a live POST /api/assistant/threads/:id/messages with x-dev-user=<owner slug> to the SAME running server (registerAssistantRoutes + Router, real localhost HTTP) and inspected the RAW response body STRING (not just the parsed object) — confirmed via .not.toContain('deepLinks') and .not.toContain('/llm-connections') on the raw text, plus explicit parsed.error.deepLinks toBeUndefined(). This rules out any possibility of the field being present-but-falsy-in-a-way-JSON.parse-hides, or the client merely choosing not to render it — the server-emitted bytes themselves carry no deepLinks key while the actor is non-admin. Restored the role_assignment (compensating UPDATE valid_until=NULL — net effect of a rollback without an actual open-transaction ROLLBACK, since a genuinely uncommitted transaction on a separate connection would be invisible to the server's own pool under READ COMMITTED and would make the probe vacuous) and confirmed deepLinks reappears for the identical actor on the identical server afterward. Full teardown of the throwaway tenant (grant/role_assignment/agent_card/employee/role/tenant rows) confirmed via a direct psql count query (0 orphan rows matching the test's display_name pattern).
